description: Remove tracks or episodes from a playlist. Max 100 entries per call.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

snapshot_id.description: Apply the removal against this playlist version instead of the latest

uris.description: URIs to remove; use { uri, positions } to target specific occurrences of a repeated URI

positions.description: 0-based index into the playlist's current item order (0 = the first item).
